test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is NOT one of the meanings of the homonym 'resolution'?

options.text: A firm decision to do or not to do something
The quality of an image or screen, especially in terms of clarity
A written agreement between two companies involved in a merger
The act of solving a problem, dispute, or contentious matter

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. A written agreement between two companies involved in a merger**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Resolution"** has multiple meanings depending on the context. Below are its primary meanings: • **Meaning 1:** A firm decision to do or not to do something. (दृढ़ निश्चय) • **Example:** She made a resolution to exercise daily and stick to a healthy diet. • **Meaning 2:** The quality of an image or screen, especially in terms of clarity. (छवि या स्क्रीन की स्पष्टता) • **Example:** The new smartphone has a resolution of 1080p, providing crystal-clear visuals. • **Meaning 3:** The act of solving a problem, dispute, or contentious matter. (समस्या या विवाद का समाधान) • **Example:** The resolution of the conflict between the two countries was achieved through diplomatic talks. • **Explanation of the Correct Answer:** The phrase "A written agreement between two companies involved in a merger" is NOT one of the meanings of "Resolution." (यह "Resolution" का अर्थ नहीं है।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. A written agreement between two companies involved in a merger**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A firm decision to do or not to do something** (दृढ़ निश्चय) • **Example:** My resolution for the new year is to save more money and reduce unnecessary expenses. • **Option 2: The quality of an image or screen, especially in terms of clarity** (छवि या स्क्रीन की स्पष्टता) • **Example:** The 4K resolution of the TV makes the visuals appear lifelike. • **Option 4: The act of solving a problem, dispute, or contentious matter** (समस्या या विवाद का समाधान) • **Example:** The resolution of the team's internal issues helped them perform better in the tournament. 48:T850, The correct answer is **option 1.**
